Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE tall Nightglass Courier comic image containing exactly TWO stacked landscape panels separated by a thin straight plain horizontal gutter. Upper is N6-02, lower N6-03. No writing, text, speech bubbles, captions, numbers or interface. Editable copy will be lettered outside each raster panel. Compose distinct scenes with clear faces at390px.

Input1 N5-14 is the actual Ilen identity and loft authority: deep-brown adult woman in her40s, short tight salt-pepper curls with crown volume, small round silver studs, ochre workshirt/slate-blue apron. Supported wide paper frame on trestle, right drying rack, LEFT dry cabinet with closed drawer/vase/bowl, backless bench below open large city window, ordinary left visitor doorway and clear working aisle. Input2 N5-38 is reference ONLY for actual current Aren and Sera, their clothes, faces, worn closed gray bag/harness, one closed cream waist wallet, one anatomical RIGHT sheath and Sera's OWN closed brown ledger. Do not import its green Ninth Store door, Toma, office background or loose mail. These are references for a new fourth-day return to Ilen's loft, not edit targets or alternate outfits.

UPPER N6-02: medium-wide view from inside Ilen's loft toward its ordinary left visitor entrance, with recognizably the same open window and paper workshop. Aren and Sera have ARRIVED together and stand still on supported floor at the doorway, clear of the working aisle. Aren front three-quarter facing toward Ilen, empty hands relaxed, one closed EMPTY gray bag worn on his back via its two brown padded straps and hipbelt; no object transfer. Sera stands just beside/behind him holding her OWN CLOSED brown ledger against her torso, no loose papers visible. Ilen has paused beside her supported paper frame at right and greets them with a small attentive smile. Aren's gentle expression carries his outside-raster line “Your answer is on its way.” This means the answer left outgoing post, not that anyone received or replied. No letter shown. Keep all three faces distinct and the supported doorway readable; leave a little calm wall/air around heads.

LOWER N6-03: change to a closer medium view of Ilen in her work area, with Sera listening from the clear visitor aisle at left and part of Aren if naturally framed. Ilen's LEFT hand rests lightly on the supported paper frame while her RIGHT empty hand indicates the nearby dry receiving cabinet/board at left, choosing this as her ordinary mail stop. Her outside-raster line is “The loft. I’ll be here most days.” Frame is fully trestle-supported, not carried one-handed; paper sheet stays on frame. Sera's same own brown ledger stays CLOSED in her hands. The dry drawer stays CLOSED. No envelope, signature, receipt, new blue sheet or written address on any surface. The courier simply listens; no rescue or postal ritual.

Continuity both panels: same FOURTH morning/day bright daylight after paid round. Aren actual plum-purple tousled hair/amber eyes/light lavender CHECKED buttoned garment over black high-neck clothes/black gloves and trousers. OLD anatomical LEFT elbow tear, anatomical RIGHT sleeve intact; ONE sheathed weapon only on anatomical RIGHT hip. Choose near-frontal three-quarter view so LEFT tear and RIGHT weapon belong to opposite correct sides; do not put a weapon on the torn side. One CLOSED cream wallet at waist, red-cord brass badge distinct. ONE gray bag worn and closed with its two brown shoulder straps/hipbelt, old gray side roll; no duplicate bag on table. Sera auburn short wavy bob and burgundy coat. Ilen's former private letter and envelope are stored out of sight in her closed dry drawer; her outgoing rust answer is away, NEVER on the board or in Aren's hands. No active magic, drawn sword, brand-new garment, keys, new characters or family reunion.

Preserve source drawing quality: expressive anime faces/clean contours, broad warm wood and cloth shading, sunlit stone and cool distant vertical city depth. Selective functional seams and edges; calm broad surfaces rather than tiny scratches/sparkles everywhere. No new fauna needed. Keep actual loft furniture arrangement and supported human poses, meaningful fresh framing in each panel, one thin uninterrupted horizontal gutter suitable for lossless crop. No raster lettering.
